name: Related Posts
description: Automatic per-post related articles (WordPress YARPP / Jetpack Related Posts parity). Ships a Verso block "RelatedPosts" that detects the current post from the URL on the public site, finds published posts sharing its category via the core public REST API, and renders responsive related-article cards with optional image, date and excerpt.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
